name: West Pendulum Steppe
core_rationale: Western wind-swept pendulum gorge of Continent 02 where Krono the Brass Titan's metronome counterweight swings across a chasm of singing copper reeds.
local_conflict: Wind-up gale-hounds and metronome-constructs patrol the brass suspension cables spanning the pendulum gorge.

portal_edges.lock_reason: The hundred-meter brass pallet-arms of Deadbeat Escapement Bluff slam shut every second; Pendulum-Keeper Horolog requires the Ruby Pallet Pin before unlocking the northern gate.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Glider scouts claim that if you catch the updraft of the Great Pendulum's swing at noon, you can soar straight up to Deadbeat Escapement Bluff without flapping once.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A sun-burnished brass pendulum disk thirty meters wide swinging silently between twin copper cliff-faces.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What subterranean chronometer vault opens only when Deadbeat Escapement Bluff locks at noon?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-krono-brass-titan and scar-brass-faultline along the western pendulum gorge of Continent 02.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: A colossal sun-burnished brass pendulum swinging between twin copper cliffs of singing reeds.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m brass suspension-bridges, 0.60m chronometer benches, and 0.14m cog-steps for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Complete 2x2 connected District matrix (hunting-area-metronome-bridge, town-metronome-pivot-citadel, dungeon-counterweight-shaft, and Mystery hunting-area-deadbeat-escapement-bluff) with construct and sky_kin families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Promotes West Pendulum Steppe to Canon while preserving leaf Mystery frontier Deadbeat Escapement Bluff behind a Fog of Lore portal.
